text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara and Rice Shower were chosen
to be featured in a special titled "Best Buddy Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please tell us about a memorable
event that left an impression on the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Im-press-shun?
Does impression mean you were surprised?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, every day is full of surprises, but...
I don't really remember them that well!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-My impressions are...!
Uhm... well...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Umm, in other words...
what is a precious memory the two of you share?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Memories?!
Every single day is packed full of memories!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm..., uhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...? So basically...
it's f-filled with memories...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The response from Haru Urara and the others
seemed a bit different from what the reporter had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
To bring out their best charms,
please give me a little time
to rethink our direction.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
How was it!? Did I do good!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Yay! Interviews are
a little tricky, but they're super fun~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? What's wrong, Rice-chan?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry I can't put it into words very well...
Even though I have so many wonderful memories with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though Rice was... so, so happy
to be featured in a special with Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Why!?
I'm, like, super happy right now!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Because getting featured together with Rice-chan is like a dream come true!!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly think of a great way
to calm down their anxiety and excitement.
choice_data_list: Give some snacks to lighten the mood.
She encourages you to go and have fun.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sweets!?
Woohoo! Thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... Rice can eat some too...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara and Rice Shower
happily munched on sweets together.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~! That was delicious!
Why are sweets always so tasty~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It makes you feel so happy, so maybe it has special magic in it...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Come to think of it,
we made carrot cake together a little while ago, didn't we~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "And after casting tons of magic spells on it, it really did become delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! Yes! I was so surprised!
My mouth was full of pure happiness...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's make some again, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Let's cast lots of good luck charms again, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That sounds wonderful!
Would you mind telling me a bit more about it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The interview resumed, resulting in a rich special feature depicting the two of them conversing happily.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: We can play?! Yay!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Tag, you're it, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eh, what!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan is 'it'~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-Wah! W-Wait up~~~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing the two joyfully running around,
a reporter quickly raised their camera.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what a great photo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha...!
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe! We did it!
Special Move... Urara Daaash!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, a photo of the two of them hanging out was featured in the article.
Among the fans, it seemed to cause a massive buzz as a god-tier shot.
